Subject: Pilot ask: extension + credits + promo

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team is excited by Redwood's latency and cost profile. We're running out of pilot runway with our data ingestion still tuning; procurement has a vendor window that closes Nov 25. To get proper exec buy-in we need: a 45–60 day extension on the pilot, an additional $40k in free credits to finish our LLM tuning, and a one-time promotional discount (target ~30% first-year) if we move to an annual commit after the pilot.

Is that something Redwood can accommodate? If you can provide a simple proposal and contract path this week we can get legal/procurement moving. I've looped in our procurement lead Priya.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex — really glad the demo landed well. We want to keep momentum and make procurement an easy yes.

Proposed immediate concession (pending internal approval):
- Pilot extension: 60 additional days from current end date
- Trial credits: $25,000 in Redwood trial credits applied to the account (one-time)
- Promotional pricing: 20% off list for year 1 if Celestia signs an annual commitment within 45 days of pilot finish

This is a one-time exception ask; it accelerates their evaluation but keeps our economics reasonable compared to the $40k ask. If that sounds acceptable I'll route for executive approval and get a redlineable DocuSign link back to you today. I attached the updated proposal and SOC summary.

Hannah

Marissa / Ben / Grace — forwarding Celestia's ask and my proposed concession below. Quick context:
- ACV opportunity: ~$350k ARR over first 12 months if they convert (product-led expansion likely across 3 lines).
- Timeline: procurement wants final vendor terms by Nov 25.
- Competitive risk: they're evaluating a self-hosted alternative that would be lower TCO if we can't remove friction now.

My ask: approval to grant a 60-day extension, $25k in trial credits, and 20% promo on year-1 (one-time). Finance likely wants the credit to be tracked as a sales allowance and legal to sign a short amendment. If you approve, I'll send updated DocuSign and an annotated MSA clause we can use.

Why this is reasonable: the credits speed validation of our production perf and reduce buyer friction; a modest promo ties them to Redwood for year 1 and helps us land the reference.

I'll need signoff by EOD Monday to make procurement's window.

Thanks,
Hannah
